about.description: Phoenix West is a beachfront condo resort in Orange Beach offering spacious vacation rentals with direct access to the sugar-white sand of Alabama's Gulf Coast. Designed for families and larger groups, Phoenix West features 1-, 2-, 3-, and 4-bedroom condos that accommodate up to 14 guests, each with expansive Gulf-front balconies and open living spaces. Guests enjoy private boardwalk access to the beach, allowing easy transitions between the shoreline and the resort. With panoramic Gulf views, large-scale amenities, and a prime Orange Beach location, Phoenix West combines residential comfort with a full-service beachfront resort experience.
about.elevator_pitch: Beachfront Orange Beach condo resort with 1-4 bedroom units, private boardwalk beach access, and comprehensive resort amenities for families and groups.
